SELECT e.id AS entry_id, e.dictionary_id, e.headword, e.headword_bare, e.headword_norm, e.root, e.root_source, e.pos, e.form, e.definitions_text, e.translation_en, e.translation_fr, e.domain, d.key AS dict_key, d.name_ar AS dict_name_ar, d.name_en AS dict_name_en, d.source_type AS dict_source_type, d.period AS dict_period, d.author AS dict_author, d.death_year AS dict_death_year
